scope: Performance-only candidate before the independent medical/social/partner integration. World48/engine50/content27 on both sides. No native-device, real frame or React claim in this core report.

inputReproduction.trialPersistence: Each fixed world is saved, loaded and committed through the real SaveRepository on on-disk Node SQLite/WAL. No life is made immortal, and no generated date, balance, result or RNG is patched. Only production-equivalent birth acknowledgement is represented directly.

interleaved.order: baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline, alternating for each sample
interleaved.forcedGc: outside both measured spans at each pair boundary when --expose-gc supplied
interleaved.cpu: process.cpuUsage includes process CPU, including V8 workers; distinct from elapsed time

sqlite.scope: Actual SQLite transaction/write timing; before/after were separate runs under shared host load. Raw reports retained. Summary recomputes nearest-rank quantiles from raw samples; raw driver uses the lower empirical quantile estimator. Do not attribute absolute run-to-run differences solely to code.
sqlite.checks: Exact final cold world and Before Age Up world, deterministic repeated outputs/commands/checkpoint sizes; backup revision checked here. Focused repository tests separately verify exact backup bytes/content, failure rollback, idempotency and restore.

limits: Shared cloud CPU/memory load causes large tails, including GC; eleven pairs are a small diagnostic cohort, not a device population.
Ordinary actions improve; first Age Up chunks and some younger full-year cases are mixed. No uniform percentage or worst-case guarantee.
No Android/iOS release-device tap latency, real frame stalls, native SQLite bridge, React publication, peak RSS or battery measurement here. UI agent supplies separate React/journal evidence.

Full integrity traversal and copying remain. An exploratory age70 first Age Up profile still spent about25–35ms rebuilding its ledger index; this is recorded as a remaining cost, not an implemented optimisation.
